title: mime_parser split_on_boundary is O(n * boundary_len): quadratic for large bodies
description: mime_parser.rs split_on_boundary calls body.starts_with(delimiter) at every byte offset in a loop, making the scan O(n * boundary.len()). For a 1 MB body with a 70-byte boundary this is ~70M comparisons. Replace with memchr::memmem::find_iter (already a transitive dep via reqwest/hyper) or std::str::find on the string slice. This is the hot path for any multipart article.
